habitat: 관목이 있는 초원, 간척으로 생긴 호수와 만
summary: 관목이 자라는 초원에 사는 새로, 우리나라 전국에 분포하며 주로 대규모 간척 사업으로 생긴 호수와 만 일대에서 지낸다. 간척지 개발과 하천 정비로 서식지가 점점 줄어들고 있다.

points.en: whole head and throat black (breeding male)
dull white supercilium and submoustachial stripe above a black malar stripe (female)

art.subject: Ochre-rumped Bunting (Emberiza yessoensis), adult male in breeding plumage (late spring): entire head, chin and throat black, without any white moustachial stripe; mantle and back warm rufous-brown streaked black; rump plain ochre-cinnamon; wings brown with rufous edges; tail dark brown with white outer feathers; underparts buffy-white, the flanks washed warm buff; small conical blackish bill; dark eye; pinkish legs.
art.pose: perched upright on a reed stem, side view
art.scene: Korean reclaimed land in late spring: grassland with scattered shrubs and reeds beside a lake formed by reclamation; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding (spring to summer), side view perched upright on a reed stem, wings slightly drooped to show the rump: whole head, chin and throat black with no white moustachial stripe, small conical bill, rufous-brown back streaked black, tawny-ochre rump

adult female (winter male similar), side view perched on a reed stem: brown crown, dull white supercilium and submoustachial stripe, black malar stripe below the cheek, rufous-brown back streaked black, tawny-ochre rump, small conical bill
art.build: Small, slim reed bunting, about the size of a sparrow but slimmer, with a rounded head and a fairly long, slightly notched tail with white outer feathers. Bill small, short and conical, finer than in other reed buntings. Legs pinkish. Perches upright on reed stems and low shrubs in grassy wetlands and clings to stems.
avoid: Do not paint a white moustachial stripe or white collar — that is Common Reed Bunting (Emberiza schoeniclus).
Do not paint a pale grey or whitish rump; the rump is ochre-cinnamon.
Do not paint a large, thick bill.
Do not paint any chestnut on the face or crown; the breeding male's head is all black.
